ranges.text:
idma_reg64_frontend #(
      .ObserverPort ( ObserverPort ),
      .BatchPort ( BatchPort ),
      .LaunchPort ( LaunchPort ),
      .ResearchPort ( ResearchPort ),
      .dma_regs_req_t  ( dma_regs_req_t ),
      .dma_regs_rsp_t  ( dma_regs_rsp_t ),
      .burst_req_t     ( idma_req_t     ),
      .DEVICE_ID       ( DEVICE_ID      ),
      .PROCESS_ID      ( PROCESS_ID     ),
      .AxiIdWidth      ( AxiIdWidth     ),
      .AxID            ( AxID           )
    ) i_dma_frontend (
      .obs_issue_o, .obs_done_o, .obs_poll_o, .batch_active_o, .batch_gap_active_o, .job_quiet_o,
      .policy_enable_i, .policy_allow_i, .policy_abort_i, .batch_reverse_i,
      .launch_hold_i, .launch_go_i, .launch_cancel_i,
      .launch_held_o, .launch_active_o, .launch_cancelled_o, .launch_error_o,

      .wdata_o          ( wdata             ),
      .rdata_i          ( rdata             ),
      .rdata_valid_i    ( rdata_valid       )

idma_fullbuffer_certificate #(
        .CapacityBytes (BufferDepth * (AxiDataWidth / 8))
    ) i_fullbuffer_certificate (
        .clk_i, .rst_ni,
        .job_fire_i (be_valid_d && be_ready_d),
        .job_done_i (idma_rsp_valid && idma_rsp_ready),
        .normal_copy_i (ttype == idma_pkg::DEFAULT),
        .length_i (64'(burst_req_d.length)),
        .src_i (64'(burst_req_d.src_addr)),
        .dst_i (64'(burst_req_d.dst_addr)),
        .permit_o (fullbuffer_job_o)
    );

    stream_fifo #(
        .FALL_THROUGH ( 1'b0         ),
        .DATA_WIDTH   ( AxiDataWidth ),
        .DEPTH        ( JobFifoDepth ),
        .T            ( idma_req_t   )
      ) i_stream_fifo_jobs_oned (
        .clk_i,
        .rst_ni,
        .testmode_i,
        .flush_i    ( 1'b0                ),
        .usage_o    ( /* NOT CONNECTED */ ),
        .data_i     ( burst_req_d         ),
        .valid_i    ( be_valid_d          ),
        .ready_o    ( be_ready_d          ),
        .data_o     ( burst_req           ),
        .valid_o    ( be_valid            ),
        .ready_i    ( be_ready            )
    );


    assign be_trans_complete = idma_rsp_valid;
    assign idma_rsp_ready    = 1'b1;

idma_backend #(
    .DataWidth           ( AxiDataWidth                ),
    .AddrWidth           ( AxiAddrWidth                ),
    .UserWidth           ( AxiUserWidth                ),
    .AxiIdWidth          ( AxiIdWidth                  ),
    .NumAxInFlight       ( NumAxInFlight               ),
    .BufferDepth         ( BufferDepth                 ),
    .TFLenWidth          ( TFLenWidth                  ),
    .RAWCouplingAvail    ( RAWCouplingAvail            ),
    .MaskInvalidData     ( 1'b0                        ),
    .HardwareLegalizer   ( 1'b1                        ),
    .RejectZeroTransfers ( 1'b1                        ),
    .MemSysDepth         ( MemSysDepth                 ),
    .ErrorCap            ( idma_pkg::NO_ERROR_HANDLING ),

.req_valid_i        ( req_valid          ),
            .req_ready_i        ( req_ready_o        ),
            .eh_i               ( idma_eh_req_i      ),
            .eh_valid_i         ( eh_req_valid_i     ),
            .eh_ready_o         ( eh_req_ready_o     ),
            .r_addr_i           ( r_req.ar_req.addr  ),
            .r_consume_i        ( r_valid & r_ready  ),
            .w_addr_i           ( w_req.aw_req.addr  ),
            .w_consume_i        ( w_valid & w_ready  ),
            .legalizer_flush_o  ( legalizer_flush    ),
            .legalizer_kill_o   ( legalizer_kill     ),
            .dp_busy_i          ( dp_busy            ),
            .dp_poison_o        ( dp_poison          ),
            .r_dp_rsp_i         ( r_dp_rsp           ),
            .r_dp_valid_i       ( r_dp_rsp_valid     ),
            .r_dp_ready_o       ( r_dp_rsp_ready     ),
            .w_dp_rsp_i         ( w_dp_rsp           ),
            .w_dp_valid_i       ( w_dp_rsp_valid     ),
            .w_dp_ready_o       ( w_dp_rsp_ready     ),
            .w_last_burst_i     ( w_last_burst       ),
            .w_super_last_i     ( w_super_last       ),
            .fsm_busy_o         ( busy_o.eh_fsm_busy ),
            .cnt_busy_o         ( busy_o.eh_cnt_busy )

idma_stream_fifo #(
        .Depth        ( NumAxInFlight ),
        .type_t       ( r_dp_req_t    ),
        .PrintInfo    ( PrintFifoInfo )
    ) i_r_dp_req (
        .clk_i,
        .rst_ni,
        .testmode_i,
        .flush_i   ( 1'b0                ),
        .usage_o   ( /* NOT CONNECTED */ ),
        .data_i    ( r_req.r_dp_req      ),
        .valid_i   ( r_valid             ),
        .ready_o   ( r_dp_req_in_ready   ),
        .data_o    ( r_dp_req_out        ),
        .valid_o   ( r_dp_req_out_valid  ),
        .ready_i   ( r_dp_req_out_ready  )

// Last flag store
    //--------------------------------------
    //if (Protocol == idma_pkg::AXI) begin : gen_last_flag_fifo
    if (1'b1) begin : gen_last_flag_fifo
        idma_stream_fifo #(
            .Depth        ( MetaFifoDepth ),
            .type_t       ( logic [1:0]   ),
            .PrintInfo    ( PrintFifoInfo )
        ) i_w_last (
            .clk_i,
            .rst_ni,
            .testmode_i,
            .flush_i   ( 1'b0                            ),
            .usage_o   ( /* NOT CONNECTED */             ),
            .data_i    ( {w_req.super_last, w_req.last}  ),
            .valid_i   ( w_valid & w_ready               ),
            .ready_o   ( w_last_ready                    ),
            .data_o    ( {w_super_last, w_last_burst}    ),
            .valid_o   ( /* NOT CONNECTED */             ),
            .ready_i   ( w_dp_rsp_valid & w_dp_rsp_ready )
        );

.r_rsp_valid_i    ( protocol_rsp_i.r_valid   ),
            .r_rsp_ready_i    ( protocol_req_o.r_ready   ),
            .r_rsp_first_i    ( r_dp_rsp.first           ),
            .r_decouple_aw_i  ( r_dp_req_out.decouple_aw ),
            .aw_decouple_aw_i ( w_req.decouple_aw        ),
            .aw_req_i         ( w_req.aw_req             ),
            .aw_valid_i       ( w_valid                  ),
            .aw_ready_o       ( aw_ready                 ),
            .aw_req_o         ( aw_req_dp                ),
            .aw_valid_o       ( aw_valid_dp              ),
            .aw_ready_i       ( aw_ready_dp              ),
            .busy_o           ( busy_o.raw_coupler_busy  )

input  byte_t [StrbWidth-1:0] data_i,
    input  strb_t valid_i,
    output strb_t ready_o,

    output byte_t [StrbWidth-1:0] data_o,
    output strb_t valid_o,
    input  strb_t ready_i
);

    // buffer is implemented as an array of stream FIFOs
    for (genvar i = 0; i < StrbWidth; i++) begin : gen_fifo_buffer
        idma_stream_fifo #(
            .type_t       ( byte_t        ),
            .Depth        ( BufferDepth   ),
            .PrintInfo    ( PrintFifoInfo )
        ) i_byte_buffer (
            .clk_i,
            .rst_ni,
            .testmode_i,
            .flush_i      ( 1'b0                ),
            .usage_o      ( /* NOT CONNECTED */ ),
            .data_i       ( data_i  [i]         ),
            .valid_i      ( valid_i [i]         ),
            .ready_o      ( ready_o [i]         ),
            .data_o       ( data_o  [i]         ),
            .valid_o      ( valid_o [i]         ),
            .ready_i      ( ready_i [i]         )

axi_mux #(
            .SlvAxiIDWidth ( DmaAxiIdWidth        ),
            .slv_aw_chan_t ( axi_dma_tr_aw_chan_t ),
            .mst_aw_chan_t ( axi_tr_aw_chan_t     ),
            .w_chan_t      ( axi_dma_tr_w_chan_t  ),
            .slv_b_chan_t  ( axi_dma_tr_b_chan_t  ),
            .mst_b_chan_t  ( axi_tr_b_chan_t      ),
            .slv_ar_chan_t ( axi_dma_tr_ar_chan_t ),
            .mst_ar_chan_t ( axi_tr_ar_chan_t     ),
            .slv_r_chan_t  ( axi_dma_tr_r_chan_t  ),
            .mst_r_chan_t  ( axi_tr_r_chan_t      ),
            .slv_req_t     ( axi_dma_tr_req_t     ),
            .slv_resp_t    ( axi_dma_tr_resp_t    ),
            .mst_req_t     ( axi_tr_req_t         ),
            .mst_resp_t    ( axi_tr_resp_t        ),
            .NoSlvPorts    ( NumDMADevices        ),
            .MaxWTrans     ( 8                    )
        ) i_dma_iommu_tr_mux (
            .clk_i,
            .rst_ni,
            .test_i      ( 1'b0              ),
            .slv_reqs_i  ( axi_dma_tr_req    ),
            .slv_resps_o ( axi_dma_tr_resp   ),
            .mst_req_o   ( axi_iommu_tr_req  ),
            .mst_resp_i  ( axi_iommu_tr_resp )
        );

        for (genvar i = 0; i < NumDMADevices; i++) begin : gen_dma_inst
            dma_core_wrap_intf #(
                .AXI_ADDR_WIDTH     ( AxiAddrWidth             ),
                .AXI_DATA_WIDTH     ( AxiDataWidth             ),
                .AXI_ID_WIDTH       ( DmaAxiIdWidth            ),
                .AXI_SLV_ID_WIDTH   ( ariane_soc::IdWidthSlave ),
                .AXI_USER_WIDTH     ( AxiUserWidth             ),
                .JOB_FIFO_DEPTH     ( 8                        ),
                // N v2: a frozen batch job is one aligned 4 KiB copy. Keep
                // its full source data until the paired write can drain, so
                // a read-ahead burst cannot block the shared R return path.
                // S and N use the same capacity; other DMA/legacy modes keep
                // the existing three-beat buffer. Larger/multi-job streams
                // are outside this prototype's dependency argument.
                .BUFFER_DEPTH       ( IOMMUNonblockMode != 0 && i < 2 ? 512 : 3 ),
                .NUM_AX_IN_FLIGHT   ( 8                        ),
                .MEM_SYS_DEPTH      ( 0                        ),
                .RAW_COUPLING_AVAIL ( 0                        ),
                .IS_TWO_D           ( 0                        ),
                .BATCH_PORT (1'b1),
                .OBSERVER_PORT      ( i == 0                   ),
                .LAUNCH_PORT        ( InclIOMMU && i < 2       ),
                .RESEARCH_PORT      ( InclIOMMU && IOMMUResearchRole != 0 && i == 1 ),

                .DEVICE_ID          ( 24'(10 + i)              ),
                .PROCESS_ID         ( 20'(20 + i)              ),
                .AxID               ( '0                       )

) i_riscv_iommu (
            .clk_i        (clk_i),
            .rst_ni       (rst_ni),
            .nonblock_enable_i(IOMMUNonblockMode == 3 ? composition_mode[0] :
                               IOMMUNonblockMode == 2),
            .policy_partition_i(IOMMUNonblockMode == 3 && composition_mode[1]),
            .policy_clear_i(composition_clear), .policy_did_i(composition_did),
            .policy_quiet_o(composition_iommu_quiet),
            .tr_req_i     (axi_iommu_tr_req),
            .tr_resp_o    (axi_iommu_tr_resp),
            .comp_resp_i  (axi_iommu_comp_resp),
            .comp_req_o   (axi_iommu_comp_req),
            .ds_resp_i    (axi_iommu_ds_resp),
            .ds_req_o     (axi_iommu_ds_req),
            .prog_req_i   (axi_iommu_prog_req),
            .prog_resp_o  (axi_iommu_prog_resp),
            .wsi_wires_o  (irq_sources[(ariane_soc::RVIOMMUCfg.NumIntVec-1)+7:7]),
            .e3_enable_i(e3_control[0]), .e3_arm_i(e3_control[1]),
            .e3_active_i(e3_control[3]), .e3_delay128_i(e3_control[7]),
            .e3_ctl_o(e3_ctl), .e3_tl_o(e3_tl), .research_o(research),
            .nonblock_fire_o(nonblock_fire), .trans_accept_o(nonblock_trans_accept),
            .nonblock_diag_o(nonblock_diag),
            // Only DMA0/1 in this prototype have the whole-copy buffers.
            .fullbuffer_jobs_i(IOMMUNonblockMode != 0 ? fullbuffer_jobs[1:0] : 2'b00),
            .trans_did_o(nonblock_did), .trans_type_o(nonblock_type)

localparam rv_iommu_cfg::rv_iommu_cfg_t RVIOMMUCfg = rv_iommu_cfg::rv_iommu_cfg_t'{
    NumOutstandingTrans : 32'd8,
    WFifoDepth          : 32'd32,
    MrifFifoDepth       : 32'd8,
    FaultFifoDepth      : 32'd8,
    NumIotlbEntries     : 32'd16,
    NumDdtcEntries      : 32'd8,
    NumPdtcEntries      : 32'd8,
    NumMrifcEntries     : 32'd8,
    InclPC              : 1'b1,
    InclAxiBC           : 1'b1,
    InclDbg             : 1'b1,
    InclATS             : 1'b0,
    MSITrans            : rv_iommu_cfg::MSI_BT_MRIF,
    IGS                 : rv_iommu_cfg::BOTH,
    NumIntVec           : 32'd16,
    NumHpmCounters      : 32'd31,
    PAddrWidth          : 32'd56,
    AxiAddrWidth        : 32'd64,
    AxiDataWidth        : 32'd64,
    AxiIdWidth          : IdWidth,
    AxiProgIdWidth      : IdWidthSlave,
    AxiUserWidth        : ariane_pkg::AXI_USER_WIDTH,
    AxiProIdWidth       : 32'd20,
    AxiDevIdWidth       : 32'd24,

localparam int unsigned MstIdxBits    = $clog2(NoSlvPorts);
  localparam int unsigned MstAxiIDWidth = SlvAxiIDWidth + MstIdxBits;

// ID prepend for all slave ports
    //--------------------------------------
    for (genvar i = 0; i < NoSlvPorts; i++) begin : gen_id_prepend
      axi_id_prepend #(
        .NoBus            ( 32'd1               ), // one AXI bus per slave port
        .AxiIdWidthSlvPort( SlvAxiIDWidth       ),
        .AxiIdWidthMstPort( MstAxiIDWidth       ),
        .slv_aw_chan_t    ( slv_aw_chan_t       ),
        .slv_w_chan_t     ( w_chan_t            ),
        .slv_b_chan_t     ( slv_b_chan_t        ),
        .slv_ar_chan_t    ( slv_ar_chan_t       ),
        .slv_r_chan_t     ( slv_r_chan_t        ),
        .mst_aw_chan_t    ( mst_aw_chan_t       ),
        .mst_w_chan_t     ( w_chan_t            ),
        .mst_b_chan_t     ( mst_b_chan_t        ),
        .mst_ar_chan_t    ( mst_ar_chan_t       ),
        .mst_r_chan_t     ( mst_r_chan_t        )
      ) i_id_prepend (
        .pre_id_i         ( switch_id_t'(i)         ),
        .slv_aw_chans_i   ( slv_reqs_i[i].aw        ),
        .slv_aw_valids_i  ( slv_reqs_i[i].aw_valid  ),

(slow_resp_valid & slow_resp_ready) |
                       (ats_trans_resp_valid_o & ats_trans_resp_ready_i) ;

    // Priority is given to normal transactions
    // We can keep the arbitrer in any case, as data_i and valid_i are '0
    // when debug/ATS are unsupported
    stream_arbiter #(
        .DATA_T   (trans_req_data_t),
        .N_INP    (3),
        .ARBITER  ("prio")
    ) i_req_arbiter (
        .clk_i          (clk_i),
        .rst_ni         (rst_ni),

        .inp_data_i     ({ats_trans_req_data_i,     debug_req_data_i,     trans_req_data_i }),
        .inp_valid_i    ({ats_trans_req_valid_i && normal_gate,
                          debug_req_valid_i && normal_gate,
                          trans_req_valid_i && normal_gate}),
        .inp_ready_o    ({ats_trans_req_ready_o,    debug_req_ready_o,    normal_trans_ready}),

        .oup_data_o     (arb_req_data),
        .oup_valid_o    (arb_req_valid),
        .oup_ready_i    (arb_req_ready)
    );

    spill_register #(
        .T          (trans_req_data_t),
        .Bypass     (1'b0)
    ) i_req_spill_register (
        .clk_i      (clk_i),
        .rst_ni     (rst_ni),

        .data_i     (arb_req_data),
        .valid_i    (arb_req_valid),
        .ready_o    (arb_req_ready),

        .data_o     (req_data),
        .valid_o    (req_valid),
        .ready_i    (req_ready)

if (NonblockEnable) begin : gen_nonblock_hit
        rv_iommu_nonblock_hit #(
            .PAddrWidth(PLEN),
            .HasMsiContext(RVIOMMUCfg.MSITrans != rv_iommu_cfg::MSI_DISABLED),
            .dc_t(dc_t), .req_t(trans_req_data_t),
            .resp_t(trans_resp_data_t), .ddtp_t(iommu_reg2hw_ddtp_reg_t)
        ) i_hit (
            .clk_i, .rst_ni, .enable_i(nonblock_enable_i),
            .window_i(n_window),
            .candidate_i(trans_req_data_i), .candidate_valid_i(trans_req_valid_i),
            .normal_fire_i(trans_req_valid_i && normal_trans_ready && normal_gate),
            .invalidate_i(iotinval_i.inval_vma || iotinval_i.inval_gvma ||
                          iodirinval_i.inval_ddtc || iodirinval_i.inval_pdtc),
            .ddtp_i(ddtp_i), .intercept_o(n_intercept), .accept_o(n_accept),
            .busy_o(n_busy), .ddtc_lookup_o(n_ddtc_lu), .ddtc_touch_o(n_ddtc_touch),
            .ddtc_did_o(n_ddtc_did), .ddtc_hit_i(cache_ddtc_hit), .ddtc_dc_i(ddtc_dc),
            .iotlb_lookup_o(n_iotlb_lu), .iotlb_touch_o(n_iotlb_touch),
            .iotlb_vpn_o(n_iotlb_vpn), .iotlb_pscid_o(n_iotlb_pscid),
            .iotlb_hit_i(cache_iotlb_hit), .iotlb_content_i(iotlb_lu_content),
            .response_o(fast_resp_data), .response_valid_o(fast_resp_valid),
            .response_ready_i(fast_resp_ready), .diag_o(n_diag)

stream_arbiter #(.DATA_T(trans_resp_data_t), .N_INP(2), .ARBITER("rr"))
        i_nonblock_response_arbiter (
            .clk_i, .rst_ni, .inp_data_i({fast_resp_data, slow_resp_data}),
            .inp_valid_i({fast_resp_valid, slow_resp_valid}),
            .inp_ready_o({fast_resp_ready, slow_resp_ready}),
            .oup_data_o(trans_resp_data_o), .oup_valid_o(trans_resp_valid_o),
            .oup_ready_i(trans_resp_ready_i)

rv_iommu_ptw #(
        .RVIOMMUCfg         (RVIOMMUCfg),
        .addr_t             (addr_t),
        .paddr_t            (paddr_t),
        .axi_req_t          (axi_req_t),
        .axi_resp_t         (axi_resp_t)
    ) i_rv_iommu_ptw (
        .clk_i              (clk_i),
        .rst_ni             (rst_ni),

        .init_ptw_i         (ptw_init),

        .active_o           (e3_ptw_active),
        .e3_level_o         (e3_level),
        .error_o            (ptw_error),
        .error_2S_o         (ptw_error_2S),
        .error_2S_int_o     (ptw_error_2S_int),
        .bad_gpaddr_o       (ptw_bad_gpaddr),
        .cause_code_o       (ptw_cause),

        .en_1S_i            (en_1S_q),
        .en_2S_i            (en_2S_q),
        .is_store_i         (is_store),
        .is_rx_i            (is_rx),
        .iosatp_ppn_i       (iosatp_ppn_q),
        .iohgatp_ppn_i      (iohgatp_ppn_q),

        .mem_resp_i         (e3_ptw_resp),
        .mem_req_o          (e3_ptw_req),

        .iova_i             (req_data.iova),
        .pscid_i            (pscid_q),
        .gscid_i            (gscid_q),
        .update_o           (ptw_iotlb_update),

        .msi_en_i           (msi_enabled),
        .msi_addr_mask_i    (msi_mask),
        .msi_addr_pattern_i (msi_pattern),
        .gpaddr_is_msi_o    (gpaddr_is_msi),

) (
    input  logic                        clk_i,
    input  logic                        rst_ni,
    
    // Init PTW
    input  logic                        init_ptw_i,

    // Error signaling
    output logic                            active_o,
    output logic                            error_o,
    output logic                            error_2S_o,
    output logic                            error_2S_int_o,
    output logic [rv_iommu::GPLEN39-1:0]    bad_gpaddr_o,
    output rv_iommu::cause_t                cause_code_o,

    // Transaction data 
    input  logic                        en_1S_i,
    input  logic                        en_2S_i,
    input  logic                        is_store_i,
    input  logic                        is_rx_i,
    input  rv_iommu::ppn_t              iosatp_ppn_i,
    input  rv_iommu::ppn_t              iohgatp_ppn_i,

    // IOTLB tags
    input  addr_t                       iova_i,
    input  rv_iommu::pscid_t            pscid_i,
    input  rv_iommu::gscid_t            gscid_i,

    // IOTLB update port
    output rv_iommu::iotlb_up_t         update_o,

    // MSI translation
    input  logic                            msi_en_i,
    input  logic [rv_iommu::GPPNW39-1:0]    msi_addr_mask_i,
    input  logic [rv_iommu::GPPNW39-1:0]    msi_addr_pattern_i,

    // Bus to send first-stage data to MSI PTW
    output logic                            gpaddr_is_msi_o,
    output rv_iommu::iotlb_stage_content_t  msi_1S_content_o,

    // Implicit second-stage translations
    input  logic                        imp_init_i,
    input  rv_iommu::ppn_t              pdt_gppn_i,
    output logic                        imp_done_o,
    output logic                        imp_err_o,
    
    // Memory interface
    input  axi_resp_t                   mem_resp_i,
    output axi_req_t                    mem_req_o,
    output logic [1:0]                  e3_level_o

// According to the value of GV, AV and PSCV, different entries are selected to be invalidated:
            /*
                |GV|AV|PSCV|

                |0 |0 |0   |    Invalidate all entries for all host address spaces (G-stage translation disabled), including those with G=1 
                                NOTE: Host address space entries are those with G-stage translation disabled. Some devices may be retained by the hypervisor or host OS
                |0 |0 |1   |    Invalidate all entries for the host address space identified by PSCID, except for those with G=1

static DEFINE_MUTEX(idma_experiment_lock);

* relevant DMA and serializes binding changes. Both endpoint locks are held
 * across validation and command submission, taken in ascending device id
 * order, and no domain->lock is taken. This only issues IOTINVAL.VMA with
 * GV/AV/PSCV clear followed by a fence; it is not an ATS/PR/PW or general
 * internal-state reset, and it never retries or resets on failure.
 *
 * Note on the current RTL: CQH advances when the fetch of the last beat
 * completes, before decode. For this strict no-ATS/no-S2, quiesced
 * experiment the CQ decodes the earlier VMA (its invalidations are issued
 * before the fetch of the following IOFENCE), so CQH passing the following
 * fence is sufficient evidence that the VMA pulse was issued. This is not a
 * general fence-execution proof.
